primary_intent: Use a friendly adult presenter's repeated card-and-tear pattern to stop the scroll, frame three short Hindi objections, and drive a direct download CTA without introducing a new product claim.
audience_and_platform: Vertical short-form social feed; viewers who understand Hindi/Hinglish source copy.

evidence.observation: First handwritten objection is held to camera, answered by yellow response subtitle, then physically torn.
The same objection-response-tear structure repeats with a second card.
The third card completes the repeated visual pattern.
Presenter makes an audible direct download/uninstall fallback statement to camera.

cut_allocation.script_instruction: Keep the adult character fully clothed, direct-to-camera, upbeat, and non-explicit; preserve first card, yellow response beat, and complete tear endpoint.
Preserve two repeated raise-hold-response-tear beats with the same room, camera, prop scale, and hand action.
Retain the source Hindi CTA cadence and friendly final smile; do not add a logo, badge, UI, or new marketing promise.

uncertainties: ASR supplies timing but not fully verified Hindi transliteration.
No target product evidence is supplied, so source promotional copy is preserved only as source material rather than being adapted into a new target claim.
